ociRepositoryApiVersion.description: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io API version of the OCIRepository.

ociUrl.description: OCI URL of the agent chart. The OCIRepository kept in every organization namespace is named after its last segment (`agent`); the organization's HelmReleases reference it by that name. Empty keeps none.

semverFilter.description: Regular expression the chart's tags must match before the range is evaluated (the OCIRepository's `ref.semverFilter`); empty filters nothing.

clusterRole.description: The ClusterRole an organization's Flux ServiceAccount is bound to in its organization namespace (rendered by the agent-platform chart).

decryptionSecret.description: The installation's SOPS key Secret in `erasure.fluxNamespace`, which the organizations' Kustomizations decrypt with; empty decrypts nothing.

name.description: The installation's Kustomization that applies the AgentPlatformOrganizations (with `deletionPolicy: Orphan`). An organization it applied is `Orphaned` while it is missing from its inventory, with reason `DeleteMerged` when it carries `agent-platform.giantswarm.io/delete-pull-request`, `MissingFromGit` otherwise. Empty: no `Orphaned` condition.

path.description: An organization's path in the source: `{parent}` and `{name}` are replaced by its parent namespace and its name. An installation puts it under its own agent-platform configuration path, outside what the installation's Kustomization applies.

kind.description: Kind of the installation's Flux source in `erasure.fluxNamespace`: `GitRepository` or `OCIRepository`.

name.description: The installation's Flux source. Set: commit mode, every organization gets, in `erasure.fluxNamespace`, a Kustomization that applies its path from this source into its namespace, and the Flux ServiceAccount that Kustomization runs as, both named after the organization namespace, bound in the organization namespace only to `clusterRole`. Empty: none. Needs `erasure.fluxNamespace`.

enabled.description: Copy the curated objects of `platformNamespace`, read-only, into every organization namespace: the Harnesses an organization's `spec.harnesses` names (pointed at its own pool and snapshot prefix, kagent memory off), the WorkerPool `workerPool` with its ServiceAccount, the Agents and AgentTemplates labelled `agent-platform.giantswarm.io/curated: "true"` (their template's `modelConfig` set to the organization's default ModelConfig) and the RemoteMCPServers they name. Needs `snapshots.bucket`, `erasure.kagent.target`, `erasure.substrate.target` and an API server that serves `kagentApiVersion` and `workerPoolApiVersion`.

kagentApiVersion.description: api.kagent.dev API version of the Agents, AgentTemplates, Harnesses, ModelConfigs and RemoteMCPServers.

workerPoolApiVersion.description: ate.dev API version of the WorkerPool.

fluxNamespace.description: The namespace of the installation's Flux source, where an organization's Flux Kustomization and Flux ServiceAccount live, labelled agent-platform.giantswarm.io/organization-uid with its UID: the erasure deletes them there. The same as the agent-platform chart's agentPlatformOrganizations.fluxNamespace. Empty: there are none.

helmReleaseApiVersion.description: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io API version of the organizations' HelmReleases.

audience.description: The audience of the ServiceAccount token sent to kagent: the controller's machine audience.

target.description: The kagent controller's gRPC API (`grpc://host:port` or `grpcs://host[:port]`), through which cleanup deletes a deleted organization's sessions, as the operator's ServiceAccount. Empty skips them; required with `curated.enabled`.

kustomizationApiVersion.description: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io API version of the organizations' Flux Kustomizations and of the installation's.

pollInterval.description: How often a cleanup step that waits for something to be gone looks again.

snapshotDelay.description: How long after the first deletion of a deleted organization's snapshot prefix it is deleted again. Keep it at least Substrate's actor workflow deadline, which ate-api sets to 5m by default, so an upload that started before the organization's last actor went has ended.

audience.description: The audience of the ServiceAccount token sent to ate-api: one its Kubernetes JWT provider accepts.

matchLabels.description: Labels a ClusterTrustBundle of `signerName` must carry to be projected (Substrate's live bundles carry `podcert.ate.dev/canarying: live`). Empty: every ClusterTrustBundle of `signerName`.

signerName.description: Signer of the ClusterTrustBundles ate-api's serving certificate is verified with, projected into the pod (Substrate's `servicedns.podcert.ate.dev/identity`). The kubelet updates the projection when a bundle changes and the operator reads it at each new connection, so a rotated CA is trusted without a restart. Needs the `ClusterTrustBundleProjection` feature. Set: `caConfigMap.name` must be empty.

key.description: Key of the CA bundle in the ConfigMap.

name.description: ConfigMap holding the CA bundle ate-api's serving certificate is verified with, for a cluster without the ClusterTrustBundle projection. Empty, with `caClusterTrustBundle.signerName` empty too: the system roots.

target.description: Substrate's ate-api (`grpcs://host[:port]`), which the operator asks until a deleted organization has no actor left. Empty skips the wait; required with `curated.enabled`.

global.description: Global values shared between all subcharts and the platform.

helmReleaseServiceAccount.description: The ServiceAccount the organization's HelmReleases run as (`spec.serviceAccountName`, which helm-controller impersonates), kept in every organization namespace and bound there to the ClusterRole `agent-platform-tenant-flux`. The same name as agent-manager's `flux.helmReleaseServiceAccount`. Empty keeps none.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion.

flavor.description: Kind of the network policies copied into every organization namespace: `kubernetes` (NetworkPolicy) or `cilium` (CiliumNetworkPolicy). Empty copies none.

names.description: Names of the network policies in `platformNamespace` copied into every organization namespace (the platform's worker policy, `substrate-workers` with Cilium, `substrate-workers-ingress` with Kubernetes network policies).

objectQuota.description: Hard limits of the ResourceQuota `agent-platform-organization-objects` kept in every organization namespace, as `<resource>: <count>`: object counts, so one organization cannot flood the API server. A key set to `null` drops its limit, also a key the chart does not set; no key keeps no ResourceQuota. A key without `/` must be a standard quota resource (`pods`, `services`, `secrets`, `configmaps`, ...): count other kinds as `count/<resource>.<group>` (`count/serviceaccounts` for the core group), or the API server refuses the ResourceQuota. The chart refuses such a key with "at '/objectQuota/<key>': got string, want null".

platformNamespace.description: The platform namespace (kagent's) the network policies are copied from.

annotations.description: Annotations of the operator's ServiceAccount, for example `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn`: the IRSA role used to delete snapshots under the organizations' prefixes of `snapshots.bucket`.

serviceAccountBindings.description: ClusterRoles bound to a ServiceAccount of another namespace in every organization namespace, such as Substrate's credential providers' Secret readers, which read the Secret an actor's credential names there. Each ClusterRole is bound by a RoleBinding named after it (listed once, not the Helm or Flux binding's name), and the operator gets `bind` on it; a ClusterRole removed from the list loses its bindings. The agent-platform chart's admission policy holds which ServiceAccounts the operator binds there.

bucket.description: Bucket of the organizations' worker snapshots: an organization's `status.snapshotPrefix` is `s3://<bucket>/<uid>`. Empty leaves it empty.

accessKeyIdKey.description: Key of the access key ID in the Secret.

existingSecret.description: Secret in the operator namespace containing the S3 credential pair. Empty uses the default AWS credential chain.

secretAccessKeyKey.description: Key of the secret access key in the Secret.

sessionTokenKey.description: Optional key of a session token in the Secret.

endpoint.description: S3 endpoint URL; empty uses the AWS endpoint.

region.description: AWS region of the bucket, the AWS_REGION of the operator; empty takes the one the pod's environment sets, if any.

usePathStyle.description: Address buckets in the URL path instead of the hostname.

syncPeriod.description: How often every organization is reconciled without a change. A change to an organization, its namespace, its objects there, a parent's organizations-admin RoleBinding, a copied network policy, a curated object or a ModelConfig in its namespace reconciles it at once.
